Roastmaster Jeff Ross joins Joe Rogan for episode 2472. Ross built fame roasting stars at Friars Club events and on TV. No insult comic works a room quite like him.

Rogan and Ross trade tales of roasts gone right and wrong. Ross shares how he writes jokes that sting but land warm. They honor dead legends of the form. The episode is brutal and fond at once. Comedy fans get a king of the roast explaining his craft, with love for the targets he burns. A roast, for him, is a love letter.
